CHAPTER.VERS: Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
so that my bonds became manifest in Christ throughout the whole praetorian guard, and to all the rest;
and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word without fear.
Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will.
The ones [that preach] from love know that I am set for the defense of the good news;
but, the ones [that] proclaim Christ insincerely from faction, think to raise up affliction for me in my bonds.
What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed; and in this I rejoice, yes, and will rejoice.

according to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing will I be put to shame, but [that] with all boldness, as always, [so] now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
But if to live in the flesh, --[if] this will bring fruit from my work, then what I will choose I don't know.
But I am in a strait between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ; for it is very far better:
